title: Admissions
heading: Admissions
content:
Entrance Exams Accepted:
  - KCET (Karnataka Common Entrance Test) - for BE
  - COMEDK UGET - for BE
  - Karnataka PGCET - for MBA/MCA/M.Tech
  - Valid GATE score - alternative route for M.Tech
Eligibility:
  Be Bachelor Of Engineering:
    Criteria: Pass in Pre-University Board (PUC) or any equivalent examination recognized by the University, with a minimum of 45% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics.
    Relaxation: 40% aggregate for SC/ST and OBC category students.
    Documents Required:
      - Original Secondary School Leaving Certificate (SSLC)
      - Original Pre-University Certificate (PUC)
      - Photocopy of Aadhaar card
      - Original Transfer Certificate (TC) and Conduct Certificate
      - Passport size photo of applicant
      - Migration certificate (for non-Karnataka students)
  Mba:
    Criteria: Pass in a Bachelor's Degree (minimum 3-year duration) from a recognized University with an aggregate minimum of 50% marks across all subjects/years, including languages.
    Relaxation: 45% for SC/ST and Category-I Karnataka candidates; reservation/concession applicable only to Karnataka candidates.
  Mca:
    Criteria: Pass in BCA / B.E. in Computer Science / equivalent degree, OR B.Sc/B.Com/B.A (preferably with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level; bridge courses required if no Maths background), with an aggregate minimum of 50% marks across all subjects/years.
    Relaxation: 45% for SC/ST and Category-I Karnataka candidates.
    Documents Required:
      - Original Undergraduate Certificate and/or provisional course clearance certificate
      - Original Undergraduate degree marks cards
      - Original SSLC
      - Original PUC
      - Photocopy of Aadhaar card
      - Original TC and Conduct Certificate
      - Passport size photo
      - Migration certificate (for non-Karnataka students)
  Mtech:
    Criteria: Pass in the qualifying examination (or equivalent, as prescribed by the Competent Authority) with an aggregate minimum of 50% marks across all subjects/semesters; valid GATE score candidates also eligible.
    Relaxation: 45% for SC/ST and Category-I candidates; reservation/concession applicable only to Karnataka candidates.
    Documents Required:
      - Original Undergraduate Certificate and/or provisional course clearance certificate
      - Original Undergraduate degree marks cards
      - Original SSLC
      - Original PUC
      - Photocopy of Aadhaar Card
      - Original TC and Conduct Certificate
      - Passport size photo
      - Migration certificate (for non-Karnataka students)
How To Apply: Prospective students can apply online via the 'Apply Now' link / Application Form on the official website (Google Form), or contact the admissions office / Principal's office directly.
Fees: Specific fee structure (semester/annual fees, hostel fees, etc.) is not published on the official website pages reviewed - prospective students should contact the admissions office for current fee details.

title: FAQs
heading: What is Shree Devi Institute of Technology (SDIT)?
content: SDIT is a private, self-financing engineering and management institute located in Kenjar, Airport Road, Mangalore, Karnataka - 574142. It was established in 2006 by the Shree Devi Education Trust (founded 1992), is affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi, and is recognized by AICTE, New Delhi.

title: FAQs
heading: Where exactly is SDIT located?
content: SDIT is located at Kenjar, Airport Road, Mangaluru, Karnataka 574142 - about 1.6 km from Mangaluru International Airport and about 12.2 km from Mangalore Railway Station.

title: FAQs
heading: What undergraduate (B.E.) programs does SDIT offer?
content: SDIT offers 8 B.E. branches: Computer Science & Engineering, Information Science & Engineering, CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning), Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Aeronautical Engineering.

title: FAQs
heading: What postgraduate programs does SDIT offer?
content: SDIT offers MBA (Master of Business Administration), MCA (Master of Computer Applications), M.Tech in Construction Technology, and a Research Centre offering PhD programs.

title: FAQs
heading: What is the eligibility for B.E. admission at SDIT?
content: Candidates need a pass in PUC (or equivalent) with a minimum of 45% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics (40% for SC/ST/OBC candidates), and must qualify KCET or COMEDK UGET.

title: FAQs
heading: What is the eligibility for MBA admission?
content: A Bachelor's degree (minimum 3-year duration) from a recognized university with a minimum aggregate of 50% marks across all subjects and years (45% for SC/ST/Category-I Karnataka candidates). Admission is via Karnataka PGCET (code B281).

title: FAQs
heading: What is the eligibility for MCA admission?
content: A BCA / B.E. in Computer Science / equivalent degree, or a B.Sc/B.Com/B.A (preferably with Mathematics), with a minimum aggregate of 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/Category-I Karnataka candidates). Admission is via Karnataka PGCET (code C476).

title: FAQs
heading: What is SDIT's KCET / PGCET code?
content: KCET code: E146. PGCET codes: MBA - B281, MCA - C476, M.Tech - T868.

title: FAQs
heading: How can I apply to SDIT?
content: You can apply online through the Application Form / 'Apply Now' link on https://sdit.ac.in, or contact the admissions office directly using the college phone numbers or principal's email (sditprincipal@gmail.com).

title: FAQs
heading: Does SDIT have a hostel?
content: Yes, SDIT has an on-campus hostel facility. Specific fee structure and capacity are not published online, so it's best to contact the admissions office for current details.

title: FAQs
heading: Does SDIT provide transportation?
content: Yes, SDIT provides a transportation/college bus facility for students, as shown on the official Campus page.

title: FAQs
heading: What facilities are available on campus?
content: The ~12-acre campus includes modern classrooms, department labs, a seminar hall, an open-air theatre, sports and games facilities, a canteen, a cafeteria, recreational areas, a library, hostel and transportation.

title: FAQs
heading: What is SDIT's placement record?
content: SDIT's placement cell reports that on average 90-95% of eligible final-year students are placed through campus recruitment in recent years, with offer letters growing from 427+ in 2016 to 492+ in 2020. Recruiters include Infosys, Amazon, IBM, Cognizant, TCS, Capgemini, Deloitte, Wells Fargo and many more. Exact yearly percentages/packages should be confirmed with the placement cell.

title: FAQs
heading: Who is the Principal of SDIT?
content: Dr. Manujesh B J is the Principal of Shree Devi Institute of Technology.

title: FAQs
heading: Who is the Vice Principal of SDIT?
content: Dr. Nethravathi P S is the Vice Principal of SDIT.

title: FAQs
heading: Who runs SDIT / who is the governing trust?
content: SDIT is run by the Shree Devi Education Trust (R.), established in 1992, chaired by Dr. A Sadananda Shetty, with Mr. Nidhish S. Shetty as Vice-Chairman and Mrs. Priyanka N. Shetty as Secretary. The trust also runs colleges in Pharmacy, Physiotherapy, Nursing, Hotel Management, Fashion Design, Interior Design, Information Science, Social Work, Commerce/BBA and Allied Health Sciences.

title: FAQs
heading: Is SDIT NAAC accredited?
content: SDIT has undergone the NAAC assessment process and has published a Self Study Report (SSR) and criteria-wise documentation on its website. The specific letter grade/CGPA was not found published on the official pages reviewed - please verify the current grade directly with the institute or NAAC.

title: FAQs
heading: What scholarships are available at SDIT?
content: SDIT offers merit- and need-based scholarships, including government schemes (Backward Welfare, Minority Welfare, Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, Technical Education Dept, Agriculture Dept), Karnataka Arya Vyshya scholarship, Sitaram Jindal Foundation, Management Concession, and more.

title: FAQs
heading: What student clubs exist at SDIT?
content: SDIT has several student clubs: Lingua Nova (language/communication), Media Mavericks (photography/videography), Coders Nexus (coding/programming), Sports Mania (sports), Cult-mosaic (cultural exchange), Finance Club, Marketing Club (MAntra), HR Club (HRiday), Samarpan (social service), and Eco Club (Sankalp). The MBA and MCA departments also run their own activity umbrellas (Meraki; SPARKLE/NIRVAN).

title: FAQs
heading: Does SDIT have industry collaborations?
content: Yes, SDIT has signed 30+ MoUs with academic institutions and companies (e.g., Blue Line Computers, SMEC Automation, iQmetrics Solutions, Indian Red Cross Society) for internships, training and collaborative activities.

title: FAQs
heading: What is the fee structure at SDIT?
content: The official website does not publish a detailed fee structure. Prospective students should contact the admissions office directly for current fee details for each program.

title: FAQs
heading: Is SDIT good for Computer Science?
content: SDIT's CSE department was established in 2006 and also offers newer specializations - CSE (AI & ML) and Artificial Intelligence & Data Science - alongside Information Science & Engineering, with dedicated labs (Data Structures, OOPS, DBMS, Networking, Algorithms, System & Internet Programming, etc.) and strong industry placement partnerships. For rankings/outcomes beyond what's stated here, verify with official NIRF/NAAC filings.
